facts.fact: The ODPC established under the Data Protection Act 2019 is operating, with Kassait as outgoing commissioner and a successor nominated on 10 November 2026.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: TechTrendsKE says the Data Protection Act 2019 has been implemented for six years, with Kassait seeking amendments.
Kassait says the ODPC took enforcement actions against the Ministry of Agriculture and Migori County Assembly, undated.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: TechTrendsKE reports an April 2025 analysis counting 51 ODPC determinations in 2024.
